name: card-review-toolkit
description: SatyaHQ: Two-image card comparison engine plus card-proofreader, card-text-repair, and card-symbol-repair. Provides pixel-level diff analysis, perceptual metrics, text/numeric audit, and structured PASS/FAIL/NEEDS_REVIEW verdicts.

interface.shortDescription: Proofread cards and repair text and symbols.
interface.longDescription: SatyaHQ v2.0.0 extends Card Review Toolkit v1.5.2 with a full-image comparison engine: SHA-256 integrity checks, pixel-level difference heatmaps, per-channel analysis, SSIM perceptual scoring, alignment-aware comparison, and classification into PASS/FAIL/NEEDS_REVIEW/NOT_RUN. All existing card-proofreader text/numeric/symbol auditing, card-text-repair, and card-symbol-repair skills are preserved and hardened. New satyahq skill orchestrates the two-image workflow.
defaultPrompt: Use $satyahq to compare my RAW and IMPROVED card images and generate a complete evidence-based comparison report.
Compare my original and enhanced card and report confirmed errors.
Repair the approved text errors while preserving the font and background.
Preview source-matched repairs for the approved card symbols.
